pick.headline: Hungary opens its border to East German refugees

evidence.title: FBIS Daily Report: East Europe, No. 174, 11 September 1989
evidence.snippet: …were not taken in. In Siofok and Balatonszeplak, part of the National Council of Trade Union hotel has been vacated, which indicates that more GDR refugees are expected. The build:ags will be reserved until 10 October. Horn To Explain on TV LD1009165189 Budapest Domestic Service in Hungarian 1630 GMT 10 Sep 89 [Text] The affair of the GDR refugees in Hungary will be settled today. Gyorgy Bernath reports from Bonn: [Bernath] Before midnight…
